messages:
mike_sales: FinTrust RFP arrived. They want a capability matrix + filled security questionnaire by EOD Tue. Key asks: KMS/HSM support (FIPS mentioned), on‑prem Private deployment options, data residency (us-east-1), dedicated capacity with burst pricing, and example SLA. Attached questionnaire: https://drive.google.com/fintrust/rfp-questionnaire.docx

samir_se: Got it — I'll draft the capability matrix. Quick Q: for burst pricing should we propose reserved + burst or hosted burst? @julia_pm any pref?

julia_pm: Recommend proposing both scenarios. Dedicated reserved for predictable throughput (with defined burst allowance) and hosted on-demand as fallback. I'll sketch two price scenarios to show tradeoffs.

samir_se: Matrix items I'll include: hosting modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), model catalog + verified perf, KV cache persistence, quantization profiles, KMS integrations (BYOK/HSM notes), audit logs, SOC2/FedRAMP status, network peering options. Elaine — can you take KMS/HSM wording?

elaine_sec: On it. Short note: we support customer-managed keys via KMS for Dedicated and Private. For HSM-level attestations: Private (on-prem) can use customer HSM; cloud Private deployments can integrate with Cloud HSM (FIPS 140-2 validated modules available depending on region). Hosted: we offer managed KMS with customer key wrapping support but not full dedicated HSM per tenant. Need to confirm whether FinTrust requires FIPS attestation from our provider or their own HSM.

mike_sales: They explicitly asked for FIPS 140-2 evidence. I'll flag to Legal. Also they asked about network peering / PrivateLink.

julia_pm: We support VPC peering and PrivateLink for Private deployments; Hosted supports PrivateLink in select regions. Add that to the matrix.

samir_se: Draft burst pricing snippet I added to the matrix (will refine with Finance):

```
Dedicated Reserved:
- base throughput: committed QPS (example: 100 qps)
- included burst: +20% throughput for up to 2 hours/day
- additional burst: billed at +50% over base rate
Hosted (on-demand):
- no reserved commit; burst subject to capacity, premium per-token rates apply
```

samir_se: Need concrete $ figures — @mike_sales / finance will propose three tiers?

mike_sales: Yes — Finance wants a 3-tier commercial: Starter (on-demand), Business (committed + moderate burst), Enterprise (dedicated SLA + custom peering + HSM). I'll draft numbers after we finalize the matrix.

elaine_sec: Uploaded a narrative sec answer to drive: https://drive.google.com/fintrust/sec-responses-v1.docx — I annotated KMS/HSM and audit log sections. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New file uploaded: /shared/sales/fintrust/capability_matrix_v1.csv (owner: samir_se)

samir_se: POC timeline proposal: 2-week eval. Day 1 kickoff + environment setup, Day 3 perf benchmarks (50k tokens), security review continuous. Need access to their test VPC for Private deploy — @mike_sales can you confirm network contacts?

mike_sales: Confirmed — FinTrust agreed to provide test VPC peering. I'll get network contact details and schedule kickoff Fri 11:00am PST.

julia_pm: Add fallback: if Private deploy not allowed, we run Dedicated in our staging with masked/sample data and a signed data handling addendum.

samir_se: I'll incorporate Elaine's sec language and push capability_matrix_v2. Plan to send full RFI package (matrix + questionnaire answers + pricing scenarios) by Mon EOD.

mike_sales: :handshake: Thanks team. Any blockers?

elaine_sec: Need Legal signoff on FIPS/HSM claims before we send — I'll escalate and update thread.

samir_se: Roger. Holding v2 until sec/legal greenlight.

mike_sales: OK. I'll follow up with client if timeline slips.

julia_pm: Thanks all — please tag updates in this thread so I can assemble the final one-pager.
